name: deadline-seance-crew
description: Ask what a release freeze keeps, and what a change does to it, from the live open issues of a Jira Cloud project.
author: hvaler
highlights: Reads open Jira Cloud issues read-only and hands them to Deadline Séance as CSV
The undertaker agent only states numbers the tools returned
A paused weekday-evening job writes tonight's death certificate

crons.name: nightly-certificate
crons.message: Write tonight's death certificate for the Jira project HB. Call jira_board_csv with project HB. Then call death_certificate with board { source: 'csv', text: <the csv> }, now = the time of this run, and freezeAt = the first Friday 18:00 after now, both as ISO 8601 times in Europe/Madrid (for example 2026-11-20T18:00:00+01:00). Nobody is away. Reply with the certificate markdown exactly as the tool returned it. If a tool returns an error, reply with that error and nothing else.
